summary: Full backend + frontend smoke testing of LUMARPA Node.js Express API (port 3001) and built React UI. All 22 pytest backend tests passed (health, stats, status, settings GET/POST, emails CRUD/import/reset/export, proxies import/reset/clear, imap-proxies CRUD, logs, worker start/stop lifecycle, SPA static + fallback). Frontend renders all 5 tabs (Дашборд, Логи, Аккаунты, Прокси, Настройки) correctly with proper Russian localisation, dark theme (#0f0f0f / #1a1a1a), data-testid coverage on all interactive elements, stat cards show live counts (7 emails, 4 proxies after test seeding), tab navigation switches content cleanly, no console/page errors. Status indicator correctly reflects worker 'error' state after expected /api/start crash (missing TARGET_URL/CAPSOLVER_API_KEY as documented).
critical_code_review_comments: src/api.js (613 lines) is borderline large — could be split into routes/emails.js, routes/proxies.js, routes/worker.js for maintainability, but acceptable for an MVP single-file API.

Worker stdout/stderr from spawn() is piped only to process.stdout/stderr — logs/<date>.log is filled by the worker's own logger; if the worker fails before logger init (as happens with missing TARGET_URL), the /api/logs endpoint stays empty. Consider also tee'ing spawn output into the log file or surfacing workerState.lastError in /api/logs response.
writeEnvFile rewrites the entire .env file silently — any comments or unknown variables outside SETTINGS_KEYS+order list are preserved but stripped of comments. Acceptable but worth documenting.
/api/logs/stream SSE has no max-listener cap; if many tabs subscribe, intervals accumulate. Minor.
POST /api/start ignores `count` (sets REGISTER_COUNT env that worker may not read) — UI exposes the field but it's a no-op; consider documenting in tooltip or removing field.
No auth on any endpoint — fine for localhost-only desktop app (Express binds to 127.0.0.1), but if API_PORT is ever moved to 0.0.0.0 this becomes exposed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 tabs render, navigation works, no errors)

test_credentials: n/a — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: TEST_user1@x.com / TEST_user2@x.com inserted via /api/emails/import; 2 browser proxies (1.2.3.4:1080, 5.6.7.8:1080) and 2 imap proxies via import endpoints. CODE_REGEX setting overwritten with TEST_VAL_<timestamp> marker (settings persistence verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App runs as `node src/api.js` on http://127.0.0.1:3001 (NOT REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — this is a Node+Express+SQLite+Vite-built-React project, not the standard React+FastAPI+Mongo stack). UI served from /app/lumarpa/src/ui/dist by same Express. To rebuild UI: `cd /app/lumarpa/src/ui && yarn build`. To restart API: `pkill -f 'node src/api.js'; cd /app/lumarpa && nohup node src/api.js > /tmp/api.log 2>&1 &`. .env at /app/lumarpa/.env. SQLite db at /app/lumarpa/data/accounts.db. /api/start is expected to fail with exit-code 1 because TARGET_URL/CAPSOLVER_API_KEY are empty — this is documented expected behaviour and correctly surfaces as status='error'. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_lumarpa_api.py covers full API surface and can be re-run on every iteration.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Worker 'error' status after /api/start is expected behaviour per problem statement (missing env vars in stock .env). All endpoints respond with correct status codes, payload shapes, data persistence verified via Create→Get round-trips (emails import → list → filter; settings POST → GET; proxies import → list; imap-proxies import → list → delete).
